content.text: Well, you are right on that point.
content.trans: 正确地说，你这个点子是正确的。

content.text: This is the reason that I don't buy leather and I try to buy synthetic products.
content.trans: 这是我不买皮革的原因，我试图购买合成产品。

content.text: At least you're doing your part.
content.trans: 至少你也在做你的部分。

content.text: My contribution is to have a pet in the house that I treat like a member of the family.
content.trans: 我的贡献是养一只宠物，我把它当作家庭的一员。

content.text: As long as you don't treat it better than your wife, it's fine.
content.trans: 长此以往，你不必比你的妻子做得更好。

content.text: Alright, so a debatable topic, animals and animal rights.

content.text: What do you think?

content.text: I would be a hypocrite if I said that it's bad to hurt animals because I'm meat-eater.
content.trans: 我如果说伤害动物是好的，因为我是肉食者。

content.text: I like to eat meat and I like to wear leather.
content.trans: 我喜欢吃肉，我也喜欢穿皮革。

content.text: But I do think it's bad to mistreat animals.
content.trans: 但是我认为应该尊重动物。

content.text: I try to buy free-range chicken or meat from places I know that treat the animals well.
content.trans: 我尽量从我知道的那些地方购买自由放养的鸡肉或肉。

content.text: I definitely disagree with poaching and with using animals, especially endangered animals
content.trans: 我完全不同意偷猎和使用动物，特别是濒危动物。

content.text: for money and cash purposes.

content.text: That's my position.
content.trans: 这句话的中文翻译是：“这是我的立场。”

content.text: Well, here I mean, I know you eat meat too.

content.text: Yeah, of course.

content.trans: 我认为即使保护动物是非常重要的话题，你也不希望

content.text: They truly believe that these things actually work or that they will help them.

content.text: Things change kind of over time sometimes quickly and sometimes slowly.
content.trans: 事物随着时间的推移会发生变化，有时迅速，有时缓慢。

content.text: But if we force change really quickly, who knows what their results are going to be.
